#+TITLE: org-xournalpp

Minor mode for working with [[https://xournalpp.github.io/][xournalpp]] notes, sketches etc. in org mode.

It's a fork from [[https://github.com/lepisma/org-krita][Org Krita]].

** Quickstart
The package is not on melpa yet. For installing, I would recommend downloading the repo as [[https://gitlab.com/vherrmann/org-xournalpp/-/archive/master/org-xournalpp-master.tar.gz][tarball]] or cloning it. Or if you are using [[https://github.com/quelpa/quelpa-use-package][quelpa-use-package]], you can do the following:

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
  (use-package org-xournalpp
    :ensure t
    :quelpa (org-xournalpp :fetcher gitlab :repo "vherrmann/org-xournalpp" :files ("*.el" "resources"))
    :config
    (add-hook 'org-mode-hook 'org-xournalpp-mode))
#+end_src

Or, if you are using Doom emacs you can add this to your =packages.el=:
#+begin_src emacs-lisp
(package! org-xournalpp
  :recipe (:host gitlab
           :repo "vherrmann/org-xournalpp"
           :files ("resources" "*.el")))
#+end_src

and this to your =config.el=:
#+begin_src emacs-lisp
(use-package! org-xournalpp
  :config
  (add-hook 'org-mode-hook 'org-xournalpp-mode))
#+end_src

=org-xournalpp= creates a new org link type called =xournalpp= that:
- when clicked on, opens xournalpp for editing the file linked, and
- shows the updated image preview inline if =org-xournalpp-mode= is enabled.

To use the package, you need to enable the minor mode =org-xournalpp-mode= in org buffer with =xournalpp= links like this =[[xournalpp:./some-file.xopp][image]]=. To create new files within the buffer itself, try calling =org-xournalpp-insert-new-image=.

To change the default template, hack =#'org-xournalpp-template-getter=. For example, you can use your favorite selection/completion like =ivy= or =helm=.

** Roadmap
1. [X] Support for multiple templates.
2. [X] Support for personal templates.
3. [X] Support for not having to give the file a name by prefix argument & setting
4. Support for multiple pages
5. Support for better image settings (width, etc.)
6. Better inline display. Right now we bypass org's inline display which means
   we miss out on basic things like setting width and height for larger images
   and other goodies. -> Partly fixed with this fork
7. [X] Better naming scheme (use -- instead of - after org-xournalpp for noninteractive functions)
